The new moments format drops you into a sub-mode for that moment which you have to click back out of to proceed with the next item-  the old way required far fewer clicks and was way easier one-handed on a phone. 

And finally, the new interface takes away the option to turn off both IR AND visible lighting on the blink mini! WHY??? You can now choose only (visible) “light on” or “light off.”  So dumb!

All the new “upgrades” seem to have been made by software jockeys (and I was one at one time!) who don’t actually USE the product.

A new version of the app has just killed the usefulness completely. Takes so long to open and load content on the app you may as well not bother. The flow on a doorbell should be- notification, open app, speak to person if not home.
Now it’s notification, open app, wait several minutes, see feed and person has gone. Recording has timed out and you don’t know where they are.

Unless this is resolved I plan to move everything over to my Tapo system which is much faster to load and recordings are longer.

Such a shame.

reviews.title: Save yourself £25 a month and don’t buy
reviews.text:
AVOID BLINK CAMERAS. ABSOLUTE SCAM!

I owned Blink cameras 10 years ago, and they did exactly what they were supposed to do without needing a subscription. I bought them again recently, expecting the same basic functionality, but what a disappointment.

If you want to watch the recordings from your own cameras, you now have to pay around £10 a month or more for a subscription. You’ve already paid for the cameras, you’ve installed them around your home, and they’re recording footage, but you can’t watch those recordings unless you keep paying every month.

What’s the point of having security cameras if you can’t watch the footage they’re recording? It’s ridiculous that you have to pay for the cameras and then pay a monthly subscription just to access your recordings.

I’m getting rid of mine and switching to a company that actually lets me record and watch my own footage without charging me every month.

Save your money. I certainly wouldn’t recommend Blink to anyone who wants to access their recordings without paying a monthly subscription.

reviews.title: Needs refining
reviews.text:
Every morning I wake up to at least 25 noticed that a cat is walking on my lawn. Admittedly my cat is often AI described as a fox, a bear, a raccoon, a deer. But, nontheless, I should be able to click on the notifications and mark it as Do Not Notify Me. My phone is set to give an audible alarm at ‘unusual activity, but if my cat is facing the camera it is often identified as a person. So ‘a person is on your driveway’ is a usual alarm notification. It’s usually my cat. Only unusual activity will give an audible notification. That’s great, but can we cut down on the quantity of motion detection notices by marking it as ‘Ok, no further notices’. 
Come on guys, give the user more options to refine the whole thing.

reviews.text: I’ve used this app and bought cameras all around the house. I’m fed up with having to pay a subscription fee for a slow app that doesn’t allow me to see near real time who’s at my door. By the time I have video footage, the person has left. Even after updates - It’s poor service and particularly when you have a monthly fee to pay.

reviews.title: VPN blocks the app
reviews.text: If you use a vpn on your phone to protect yourself the Blink app will be block and the fix is to turn off the vpn everytime someone rings the doorbell. Absolutely useless, waste of money

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Do not buy this as it works fine when you subscribe and as soon as you don’t pay Amazon it stops working

reviews.title: Notifications
reviews.text: Since the latest update i don’t recieve any notifications gor movement. Only when door bell pressed

reviews.title: Complete rubbish
reviews.text: Had my door bell and sync module so I could plug a usb stick in for local storage a few years ago and had nothing but issues. The App kept on forgetting it had a doorbell camera and every few weeks everything just stopped working and I had to reset everything. Now the app just says buy a storage plan at whatever per month. What a rip off paid massive money for this system but now I’ve now got a much better unit at a much cheaper price from tik tok with no subscription. Never using any blink products again.

reviews.title: Disgusting advert practices
reviews.text: Full screen captive adverts now showing before cameras will load.

reviews.title: Stupid AI stops clips loading
reviews.text: Blink you owe me at least 3 months free extra cloud.  One for the stupid AI not working and constantly crashing app on iPhone 17 pro max.  Two for lack of access and you costing me a month of access via Amazon when I had subscription when it didn’t work and had to cancel and lost a months subscription  cost and a third when I bought new device and the device wouldn’t even mount didn’t have the right equipment and didn’t come with a free Blink months subscription. reviews.title: Must do better
reviews.text: Despite having the temperature setting to show in Celsius why do I get a message saying one of my cameras is at 93F. Who uses Fahrenheit these days - oh wait! Got to be America.

reviews.title: No support!
reviews.text: Just bought a new doorbell, because the original Blink was just so slow to connect. It came with a new hub, so because the old system was so glitchy I decided to install it as a new system. That was my first mistake, because the original cameras, although I’d deleted them on the old system, were still registered to it and couldn’t be used. Tried to get support, but the phone number for Europe & the UK was disconnected. No email available, and all the AI assistant could do was refer me to the website, where the links didn’t work. So I’m stuck until such time as Blink get their act in gear and offer a working support system. My advice until then - don’t buy Blink products!

reviews.title: Laggy delayed and unresponsive app
reviews.text:
It’s finally driven me to the edge to leave a review…2 year owner viewpoint:-
If someone presses the doorbell - by the time the app connects the person has not only left the street, they’re probably dead by now. It’s terrible. 
Next the app tries to force you to use the cloud storage. Every time it switches storage to cloud even though I’m not subscribed. Click on choose local storage when looking at the clip it’s saved, it thinks for a few seconds and switches back to cloud again. Looking for a new doorbell provider as these arent worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Constantly Poor
reviews.text: Used blink for 2 years with 5 cameras but it’s become unuseable. If the app actually opens you can’t open the cameras. 2 of my cameras constantly lose connection and when they work all you hear is a loud tone. Was ok, now very poor, time to move on.

reviews.title: Appalling
reviews.text: Since the latest app update, all our cameras have stopped working and despite hours of trying different things, and MANY emails to the (exceptionally useless) ‘customer service’, we still have no cameras. Absolute disgrace considering how much we have wasted on this service

reviews.title: Forcing subscriptions
reviews.text: Whilst it will happily let you delete multiple selected clips as once from cloud storage (part of a subscription) the same is not possible for local clips. This is confirmed by support and so you either delete one at a time, all at once or have to connect the flash drive to a computer to manually do it. More sly moves by Blink to force subscriptions

reviews.title: Potential Scam?
reviews.text:
Blink automatically signed me up for a paid AI subscription without permission. 

Not only was the feature useless but reading their terms it looks like it would have automatically charged me for a years subscription if I hadn’t cancelled it. 

Frankly they should be ashamed.

reviews.title: Now truly awful
reviews.text:
This used to be a half-decent app, but no longer.

Developers have decided that it is more important to show loads of ads for other Blink products, rather than provide a good UX for using the ones that you’ve already paid for.

Greedy, stupid thinking that means I won’t be buying any more Blink kit.

reviews.title: Waste of time

Now you have ruined it with the latest updates. Now the camera’s on live view only stay live for 5 minutes then turn off and now  we can’t look back on the camera to follow him around the house because half of what should be  recordings are missing where now the camera’s only work sometimes  with the recordings which to us is now a waste of time very disappointing and now a waste of time having them

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text: This has to be the worst, user unfriendly app I had the misfortune of having to use. From inane password requirements, to being constantly automatically logged out “for security purposes”, to cameras not connecting, issues with Alexa integration. I will avoid anything Blink related in the future.

reviews.title: Home cameras
reviews.text:
Poor night vision, poor connection to servers, slow to open app. 
At best these are poor.

reviews.title: Latest update annoying
reviews.text: The thing I loved about Blink is I wasn’t trapped into needing a subscription, I “wasn’t” punished for that either, until the last update, now the default setting to view clips is the cloud, so EVERY time I want to see a clip I have to switch to the SD card, may seem like a minor thing but it’s clearly to annoy the life outta you so that you upgrade to cloud access. Well you couldn’t be more wrong I’ve since stopped recommending blink to family and friends, no longer a product I trust. What a shame
